Private Function Digest(wb As Workbook) As String Dim s As String, m As Object, lo As Object, c As Object, cell As Range On Error Resume Next s = "maps " & wb.XmlMaps.Count For Each m In wb.XmlMaps s = s & " [" & m.Name & " " & m.RootElementName & " " & m.RootElementNamespace.Prefix & " exportable " & m.IsExportable s = s & " " & m.ShowImportExportValidationErrors & m.SaveDataSourceDefinition & m.AdjustColumnWidth & m.PreserveColumnFilter s = s & m.PreserveNumberFormatting & m.AppendOnImport & " " & m.Schemas(1).Name & " " & m.Schemas(1).XML & "]" Err.Clear Next Err.Clear For Each lo In wb.Worksheets(1).ListObjects s = s & " {" & lo.Name & " " & lo.Range.Address & " " & lo.TableStyle & " " & lo.ShowAutoFilter & " " & TypeName(lo.XmlMap) For Each c In lo.ListColumns s = s & " " & c.Name & "=" & c.XPath.Value Next s = s & "}" Next Err.Clear For Each cell In wb.Worksheets(1).Range("A1:J12") If cell.XPath.Value <> "" Then s = s & " " & cell.Address(False, False) & ":" & cell.XPath.Value If Not IsEmpty(cell.Value) Then s = s & " " & cell.Address(False, False) & "=" & TypeName(cell.Value) & ":" & cell.Value & ":" & cell.NumberFormat Err.Clear Next Digest = s End
